title: El-Sayed’s Narrow Win Sets Up the Left’s Biggest Swing-State Test of the Fall
partialText: Abdul El-Sayed’s Senate candidacy poses a critical challenge for  Democrats’ ascendant progressive wing: Can an insurgent candidate, with unabashedly liberal positions, win a general election in a moderate state?

title: Suspected Iran Cyberattacks on U.S. Water Supply Follow Years of Warnings and Neglect
partialText: Federal and state officials are racing to address an assault on the nation’s water supply that they believe is the work of Iranian hackers.

title: Trump Seeks a Boost for Hemp That Would Benefit a Top Aide’s Family
partialText: At the White House’s request, senators tucked a change sought by the hemp industry into a crucial spending bill. It would benefit the son-in-law of Susie Wiles, the president’s chief of staff.

title: Trump’s Push for More A.I. Data Centers Will Mean Major Air Pollution
How China’s A.I. Is Surging Across Africa
partialText: In African tech hubs, developers are picking China’s cheap, freely available artificial intelligence models over more powerful U.S. ones.

title: The U.S. Relies on Family Caregivers. Millions of Them Are Kids.
partialText: The modern health care system requires the work of caregiving to fall to whoever else lives in a household — even if they’re kids.

title: How the Ukraine War Became a Fight for the Skies
partialText: Russia and Ukraine are producing ever larger numbers of innovative aerial weapons, hoping for a breakthrough as ground combat is largely frozen.

title: Russia’s Deadly Missile Attack on Kyiv Exploits Ukraine’s Depleted Air Defenses
partialText: At least 17 people were killed, officials said, as the country runs desperately low on interceptor missiles that could fend off Russian bombardments.

title: Lobga Rangzen, the Tibetan Activist Who Set Himself on Fire in Manhattan
partialText: No one doubted the intensity of Lobga Rangzen’s commitment to a Tibet free of Chinese control. But they were not prepared for what he did next.

title: Israeli Strikes May Undermine Trump’s Peace Plan for Gaza
partialText: President Trump announced a proposal aimed at achieving the disarmament of Hamas and an Israeli withdrawal. Israel ramped up attacks on the Palestinian enclave.

title: Israel Strikes Lebanon After Accusing Hezbollah of Cease-Fire Violation
partialText: At the same time, Israeli and Lebanese negotiators were holding talks in Rome aimed at fostering a long-term diplomatic settlement.

title: Houthis Threaten to Expand Red Sea Attacks, and Claim Strike on Saudi Tanker
partialText: Saudi Arabia has not commented on the claim by the Houthis, who are backed by Iran and have vowed to close “all access routes” to Saudi oil shipments.

title: How Malta Became a Tax Haven for Crocs and Other U.S. Companies
partialText: The Mediterranean archipelago is a hot destination for U.S. companies seeking to shield profits from income taxes.

title: What One Witness Saw Before a Spokane Wildfire Started
partialText: A resident of Spokane County, Wash., said he noticed a man acting suspiciously and called 911 after seeing smoke. The police later arrested a suspect tied to one of the wildfires in the area.

title: Climate Change Comes to Sesame Street
partialText: An episode this week focuses on the dangerous effects of warming, without mentioning climate change.

title: ‘Ted Lasso’ Draws Fans to Richmond, a Picturesque London Suburb
partialText: Fans of the warmhearted Apple TV show flock to Richmond-upon-Thames, which has long been a destination for visitors and film location scouts.

title: On ‘Ted Lasso,’ Hannah Waddingham Is Ruthless. Off Camera, She’s ‘Quite a Goofy Nugget.’
partialText: Hannah Waddingham is a rare British actor to beat a path from musical theater to the screen.

title: The Tradwife Illusion Meets the Anti-Trump Reality
partialText: Nara Smith’s illusion meets the anti-Trump reality.

title: Lessons on the Way to 100
partialText: We want to hear from people who aspire to live long lives — maybe even to 100 or beyond — about how you hope to do it and, perhaps, how you have been inspired by others who have made it there.

title: Perez Hilton Is Hospitalized After Appearing to Harm Himself on Livestream
partialText: Law enforcement and emergency workers responded to Mr. Hilton’s house after he appeared to hurt himself on a TikTok stream Tuesday.
